minutes.title: Meeting Minutes
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed remote control design, market survey findings, and material options. Decisions were made to combine designs, incorporate speech recognition, and use solar power for energy source. Next steps include reviewing casing options with the manufacturing team and conducting user tests on scroll wheel functionality.
decisions: We need to combine ideas from different designs.
We will incorporate speech recognition software into the design.

actions.task: Discuss findings of remote control market survey
Present new remote controls designs with graphical interface and scroll-like mouse
Review old remote controls for essential pieces of functionality
Discuss casing options with manufacturing team.
Conduct user tests on scroll wheel functionality.
Discuss and decide on the material, colors, and shape of the device
Work on giving Person_1 a model in clay
Save and send the last message to Raj
